messages:
Aisha (AE): Meridian Health POC kickoff - they need SSO (SAML), SCIM for ~15k users, RBAC mappings from Okta, domain verification, EU data residency. Need POC pricing + SQ answers by Fri.
Carlos (SE): SAML + metadata import OK, cert rollover supported. SCIM v2 push + role mapping supported; nested groups flattened. Recommend one-time bulk import then delta sync.
Priya (SRE): Hosted eu-west-1 demo fine for EU residency. Dedicated gives VPC + customer KMS but ~2wk lead. I can spin up hosted demo in ~48h.
Liam (Security): I'll take the SQ. Immediate gating: DPA EU addendum, keys at rest in EU, SAML must include email/sub/groups. SCIM over TLS (mTLS optional for private).
Aisha (AE): Pricing ask - they prefer a 3-month committed POC if it lowers risk.
Carlos (SE): Ballpark: Hosted trial: usage + $3k/mo support retainer or $5k credit trial. Dedicated POC: ~ $22k-26k/mo (2x A100 equiv) w/ 15% intro discount possible.
Priya (SRE): Ops: for 15k initial import Hosted will need bulk window; if they want <24h cutover pick Dedicated. I'll enable temporary SCIM rate bump for the POC.
Aisha (AE): Action items: Carlos -> SAML/SCIM config + claim mapping (EOD tomorrow). Priya -> spin demo env (48h). Liam -> annotated SQ (72h). I'll draft pricing options.
Carlos (SE): I'll drop sample mapping + curl examples in thread.
ops-bot: demo-hosted-eu build queued by Priya (SRE) -> job #512
Aisha (AE): Thanks team - will consolidate and send proposal once we have config + demo link. Keeping thread open for follow-ups.
